Lil Wayne, Karol G, Smashing Pumpkins join 2027 Hollywood Walk of.

32 entertainment figures have been selected for the 2027 Hollywood Walk of Fame. The Fanning sisters will make history with the first joint star ceremony for a sister duo. Recipients have two years to schedule their star ceremonies.

Disney layoffs hit Pixar Animation Studios with hundreds of jobs cut.

Disney confirmed it is cutting several hundred jobs across its entertainment divisions, with the majority impacting Pixar's production and operations teams. The layoffs affect 108 employees at the Bay Area studio, despite Pixar's strong box office performance this year.

Are these layoffs a necessary reset or a dangerous gamble for Pixar?

AI-assisted recap by The Screen Report.

#Pixar #Disney #BoxOffice #MovieNews
items.firstComment: This is a reckless cost‑cut move that undermines Pixar’s creative future right before Toy Story 5.

fb.description:

items.igCaption:
Tom Holland will perform all dance scenes in the Fred Astaire biopic.

Tom Holland plans to shoot all dance sequences in single, continuous takes to mirror Fred Astaire's style. He described his first rehearsals as a mix of excitement and absolute dread. The film is in development with Paul King directing and Steven Levenson writing the script.

Send this to your friend who loves musicals!

AI-assisted recap by The Screen Report.

#MovieNews #Hollywood #TomHolland #FredAstaire
items.firstComment: Calling this reckless: without a stunt double, one mistimed step disrespects Fred Astaire’s precision and puts the entire film at risk.

fb.description:

items.igCaption:
Famous Amos cookie brand gets its own streaming series 'Famously You'

The streaming series 'Famously You' is based on the Famous Amos cookie brand and will premiere exclusively on The Roku Channel on July 24. Gabrielle Union is an executive producer, and the series is created and hosted by Rev Shawn Amos, son of founder Wally Amos. The show features guests with unique passions and a lineup including Robert Ri'chard and Rachel Dratch.

Mark July 24 and send 'Famously You' to someone who grew up with Famous Amos cookies.

AI-assisted recap by The Screen Report.

#MovieNews #Hollywood #FamouslyYou #TheRokuChannel
items.firstComment: Rev Shawn Amos hosting is the only right choice — Wally Amos’s legacy stays authentic only through his son.
